system.effect: Once per turn, when declaring a single-target damaging Action with this weapon, you may include one additional legal target. Both targets must be within this weapon’s Range and within 1 unit of each other. Roll at least 3 dice and resolve one roll against both targets.
system.special: Use the same Effect and Surges for both targets. The Action and its Rider each resolve once; see D4.
system.flavor: A controlled two-target alternative to Heavy Grip.
